name: paper_tabular
description: The paper's tabular and text datasets (constraint-free and constraint-aware prompts). Fetch data first: python -m evaluation.datasets.fetch --group paper

prompts.free: Build a model to classify banana quality as good or bad from the measured attributes.

constrained.text: Classify banana quality with an F1 score of at least 0.98.

prompts.free: Predict whether a software module has defects from its code metrics.

constrained.text: Predict software defects; the macro F1 must be at least 0.70.

prompts.free: Predict the age of a crab from its physical measurements.

constrained.text: Predict crab age with an RMSE below 2.2.

prompts.free: Classify e-commerce product descriptions into their product category.

constrained.text: Classify product descriptions into categories with at least 95% accuracy.
